# ABBA / fABBA / QABBA C++ porting report

**REWRITE_DONE — FULL_PARITY, SEMANTIC**, standalone package, specification V3.0. Scope is exactly the three source algorithms requested on 2026-10-20, acquired directly from their GitHub repositories. This report does not sign Benchmark integration, formal ranking or upstream frame compatibility.

| Algorithm | Frozen upstream commit | License/source route |
|---|---|---|
| ABBA | 614d56841cd2f1c2925cea4d2c2648a7b2ac791d | MIT Python translation; patched retained CKmeans native component with LGPL >=3 ancestry |
| fABBA | d8727ecffd6232308898d7bcb2415187ab456c57 | BSD-3-Clause Python/Cython translation, v1.5.3 |
| QABBA | abfd22739b8a2d625f1538a7de9abe3a55f04471 | MIT Python/Cython translation, v0.2.0 |

The shared P2 pipeline includes segmentation, codebook training, symbol assignment, signed codebook quantization where applicable, grid alignment, reconstruction, model reuse and a new model-inclusive AFS1 container. Source theoretical storage is kept separate from physical FinalBits. C++17 and C11 public APIs execute without Python; Python is used only for independent oracles. The earlier Benchmark vendors were not used as implementation inputs and have not been changed.

G0–G2 source discovery, closure, language/license audit, contracts and capability plans are frozen. G3 source/compiled-backend differences, real data, golden/random/edge cases and all mandatory paths pass. G4 native API guard/canary/capacity/overlap/immutability/OOM tests, full accounting and cold decode pass. G5 retained source scalar/compiled/threaded capabilities pass; no invented SIMD or GPU claim. G6 GCC/Clang, x86_64/aarch64, sanitizer/fuzz/static analysis, independent performance, exact reproducibility, offline package recovery, notices and documentation pass. All 29 required capability rows are mapped and pass without a waiver.

Direct complete-source suites: ABBA 42 tests, fABBA 13 core tests, QABBA 5 API tests. Python and Cython semantic suites each have 408 principal + 262 parameter-path cases. Each backend has 309 expanded image/width/method/real-path/interchange cases. Additional boundary, sorting/model-reuse, unseeded properties and 120 full dataset/frame objects are retained in the indexed reports. The dataset report records original input/reconstruction hashes, sample durations, metrics and FinalBits. ASan/UBSan/LSan, TSan, persistent OOM, guard pages, mutation tests and coverage-guided fuzzing validate the native closure, including byte codecs built from source.

Material semantic clarifications are explicit: fABBA Python/Cython splist differences; source QABBA symbol/center ordering; codebook quantizer state missing in source portable representations; first-missing QABBA starts; source empty/nonpositive-interval behavior; case-sensitive QABBA filling; fallback custom alphabets; source 63/64-bit conversion; derived overflow and bounded resource rejection. See docs/SEMANTIC_AUDIT.md and docs/CONTRACT.md. The public JSON symbol result uses lists; string inverse input is accepted. No arbitrary Python object/pickle compatibility is claimed. No strict pointwise error bound is invented.

Native CKmeans modifications are a local comparator, RAII storage/resource bounds and initialized auxiliary storage. Numeric decisions are checked against the unpatched source. The JSON dependency's bounded-depth destructor performs no allocation during OOM cleanup; core value construction avoids a GCC 11 nested-initializer cleanup defect, independently controlled with Clang. Versioned patches and complete retained upstream notices are included. Linked byte codecs are zlib 1.2.13, Zstd 1.5.6, bzip2 1.0.8 and liblzma 5.2.5; SBOM and full file hashes cover the source/build closure.

Performance is standalone native encode/decode timing including fitting, allocations, serialization/parsing, model and checksum. Nine isolated runs (three processes per natural dataset), two warmups and 15 repetitions per object are recorded; no source speedup or formal ranking is claimed. Two independent offline builds have 10 identical artifacts. An exported package outside this workspace independently rebuilds and replays both C++ and complete-source oracles without network access.

Validation identity and limitations are in qualification-summary.json; per-gate evidence, per-capability matrices, dataset report, build reproducibility, API/security/format docs and dependency provenance are separate reviewable files. Reproduction commands are in README.md. All source snapshots remain unchanged; generated reference bindings live in a separate oracle-runtime. Release source and notices permit inspecting/rebuilding/relinking the retained LGPL component. No unrelated algorithm or Benchmark registry/adapter was modified.
